title: Maximum Subarray Sum (Relaxed) (Domain Shift)
description: Given an string of integers, find the maximum sum of any contiguous subarray within the array. This is a classic problem known as Kadane's algorithm problem.
input_description: The first line contains an integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 10^5), the number of elements in the array. The second line contains n integers representing the array elements.
output_description: Output a single integer representing the maximum subarray sum.
